summary: GreenPower Motor Company filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 16, 2026, disclosing a Nasdaq notice received October 15, 2026 that its shares closed below the $1.00 minimum bid for 30 consecutive business days, placing it out of compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rules. The company has 180 calendar days to regain compliance by closing at or above $1.00 for at least 10 consecutive business days, with a possible additional 180-day extension if it meets all other Nasdaq Capital Market initial listing standards and provides written notice of intent to cure. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation applies; the structural overhang is a potential bid-price cure such as a reverse split, with risk-arb focus on compliance progress and dilution risk.
